reviews.review: Еще не понял, но очень интересно

this game good.
from the lore to the Loadout crafting it is all great.
(execpt Nerude I personaly strugle finding the correct way)
I Love how well crafted the Bosses are. Rewarding replays in every difficulty with new Guns/Melees/Armor/Talismen/rings/Attributes/Archetypes
I consider my selfe to be very thoroug in item collection and I think I only have roughtly 70% of everything you can collect just because the entire Worldsystheme is that intertwined, like landing a killing blow on a Specific boss with a specific weapon to get an extra reward, the way you unlock some Heart relics or Archetypes like Archon is just impossible to find on accident or without a guide. Despite that endless ammount of stuff you can gather and find by trying random stuff is amazing.
This game has almost endless ways you could play it for example like in my case trying to finish the game on the hardest difficulty with only melee weapons. Just the feeling alone by beating the entire game in Apok with only my trusty melee weapons and unlocking the Final Melee weapon was an amazing experiance. (you just have to finish the game in Apok to get the Melee weapon I just wanted to unlock it my way of playing with a selfe imposed challange)
You also dont have to create selfe imposed challanges you can just pick two diffrent Classes/Archetypes and instead of being an Imovable wall with Challanger|Medic you can be a powerfull and fragile instakill Wizzard with Archon|Ritualist/Invoker, want to have a layed back experiance? try Handler|Summoner Letting your friends and helpers do the heavy lifting with a safety net when you go down.
I have not nearly played enoth to warrant a better formulated review but since I own this game since launch and have Loved it since back then oh god its been 3 years
I dont remember elden ring having guns?
I like the pistol that sounds like you're slamming a hammer on a solid wood door as hard as you can
